note_gaps: All specs are press-relayed vendor claims (a newsletter and an Interesting Engineering article), not measurements; no datasheet exists. Weight (907 g) is a unit conversion from 'under 2 pounds' and it is unstated whether the pump is included. Fingertip force, control rate and price are unstated; the hand is not sold separately (part of the 279-unit Clone Alpha). The bib's year (2024) predates the sources' own dating of the hand demo to November 2025.
actuation: hydraulic artificial muscle ('Myofiber' — small water-filled tubes that contract when pressurized), carbon-fiber bones and ligament-style tethers, driven by a 500 W water pump and 36 electro-hydraulic valves; each Myofiber generates up to 1 kg grip force, survived 650,000 test cycles
tactile: pressure pads in the palm detect grip firmness (count not given); 70 inertial sensors track angle/speed (proprioception, not tactile)
spec_caveat: 'under 2 pounds' is an upper bound, and the source does not say whether the 500 W pump and 36 valves are inside it
